bus_voltage.definition: Bus voltage(s) this BMS supports (by series count). A list means configurable across buses.

comms.definition: Has a data link (Bluetooth and/or CAN/RS485). CAN/RS485 closed-loop is only useful with a matching inverter.

guidance: One BMS per series string of bare cells, sized to the bus (series count) and the pack's discharge current. Loads here are small (~10-80 A depending on bus), so a 100 A board is 2-5x margin.
Simple/dumb boards (FET, passive balance, no radio) just protect; smart boards add Bluetooth so you can watch per-cell voltage on hand-built packs (recommended for new unmatched cells).
Active balancers (JK ~2 A, Daly/ANT ~1 A) settle fresh prismatic cells far faster than passive bleed (~30-100 mA). A passive BMS + separate active balancer is also an option.

'Inverter BMS' (JK PBxx, Seplos 10E) = smart BMS + active balancer + closed-loop CAN/RS485 to a specific inverter protocol; the CAN loop is only valuable with a matching inverter, but the active balancer alone can justify it.
Use a COMMON-PORT board for solar (charge + load share one bus); separate-port units are the wrong topology.
JBD/Overkill boards are being discontinued (stock-only). JBD/JK/Daly/Seplos/ANT are heavily cloned - buy from the brand store or a known reseller.

Considered and excluded from this list (don't fit the single-part FET model): Chargery (drives an external contactor you size yourself) and Batrium (industrial distributed, ~$650, multi-kg) - both overkill/ill-fitting for a portable tent kit.

parts.name: Daly Standard 4S 12V 100A (no BT)
parts.notes: Cheapest real option; no cell visibility - weak for new unmatched cells.

parts.name: JBD/Overkill Solar 4S 120A
parts.notes: Best app/support in class; low-temp cutoff. Being discontinued (stock-only).

parts.name: JKBMS JK-PB2A16S10P inverter BMS 16S 100A 2A active
parts.notes: 2A active balancer + BT/RS485/CAN; heavy aluminum body; CAN wasted without matching inverter.

parts.name: JKBMS JK-BD6A24S10P smart 8-24S 100A 0.6A active
parts.notes: Best value multi-S: one light board covers 24V & 48V with active balance + BT. Confirm series count.

parts.name: Daly Smart 8-24S 100A 1A active (BT+RS485+CAN)
parts.notes: One part covers 8S & 16S; CAN only useful with matching inverter.

parts.name: ANT Smart BMS 8-22S 220A
parts.notes: Very flexible/high-current; app/firmware least polished, thin docs (tinkerers).

parts.name: Seplos 10E / BMS 3.0 8-16S 200A
parts.notes: Powerwall-grade: LCD, BT/CAN/RS485, drives external active balancer; overkill for a tent but robust.
